abstract: This is a case report of an endodermal sinus tumor arising in the stomach of a 72-year-old Japanese woman. The tumor showed Borrmann 2 type at the mucosal surface, and the main mass occupied the subserosal layer with outgoing extension. Microscopically, the tumor showed typical characteristics of the endodermal sinus tumor, associated with embryonal carcinoma, poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma and well differentiated tubular adenocarcinoma. Alpha-fetoprotein was detected in the serum of the patient by radioimmunoassay and within tumor tissue by immunohistochemical techniques. Ultrastructurally, a characteristic basement membrane-like material has been identified in intercellular spaces.
abstract_ja: 72歳の日本人女性の胃に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。腫瘍は粘膜表面でBorrmann 2型を示し、主病変は漿膜下層を占めて外方向性の進展を示した。組織学的に、腫瘍は卵黄嚢腫瘍の典型的な特徴を示し、胎児性癌、低分化腺癌、高分化管状腺癌を伴っていた。患者血清中のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)はラジオイムノアッセイにより、腫瘍組織内のAFPは免疫組織化学的手法により検出された。超微細構造では、細胞間腔に特徴的な基底膜様物質が認められた。
